paper.title: A Contextual-Bandit Approach to Personalized News Article Recommendation

settings.name_in_paper: K-armed contextual bandit with linear payoffs (disjoint linear model)
unmapped: Disjoint model: each arm a has its own unknown parameter theta_a^*, E[r_{t,a}|x_{t,a}] = x_{t,a}^T theta_a^*
Regret is against the arm with maximum expected payoff at each trial
settings.definition_quote: we assume the expected payoff of an arm $a$ is linear in its $d$-dimensional feature $\vecb{x}_{t,a}$ with some unknown coefficient vector $\pmb{\theta}_a^*$; namely, for all $t$, \E[r_{t,a}|\vecb{x}_{t,a}] = \vecb{x}_{t,a}^\mt\pmb{\theta}_a^*.

settings.name_in_paper: Offline evaluation of a bandit algorithm from uniformly-random logged events
settings.out_of_scope_reason: Off-policy evaluation (replay) of a bandit policy from logged data; not a regret/identification bandit problem.
unmapped: Logged events drawn i.i.d. from unknown distribution D over (x_1..x_K, r_1..r_K) with uniformly random logging policy
settings.definition_quote: we suppose that there is some unknown distribution $D$ from which tuples are drawn i.i.d.~of the form $(\vecb{x}_{1}, ..., \vecb{x}_{K}, r_{1}, \ldots, r_{K})$ ... only the payoff $r_a$ is observed for the single arm $a$ that was chosen uniformly at random.

conditions: logging policy chooses each arm uniformly at random

source.label: thm:simulation
source.quote: For all distributions $D$ of contexts, all policies $\pi$, all $T$, and all sequences of events $h_T$, \[ \Pr_{\mbox{Policy\_Evaluator}(\pi,S)}(h_T) = \Pr_{\pi,D} (h_T) \] where $S$ is a stream of events drawn i.i.d. from a uniform random logging policy and $D$. Furthermore, the expected number of events obtained from the stream to gather a history $h_T$ of length $T$ is $KT$.

results.notes: Not a regret bound: the theorem says replay evaluation is unbiased (every history has the same distribution) and that, in expectation, exactly KT logged events are needed to collect T retained events. T here is the number of retained events. The Õ(sqrt(KdT)) regret of LinUCB is only claimed informally (no formal statement or proof), so it is not recorded.
